description: bikedata is a dataset or data collection listed in Awesome Sustainable Technology, a curated list of open-source sustainability projects under the section "Mobility and Transportation", published or maintained by ropensci (repository owner; maintainers as on the project page). aims to enable ready importing of historical trip data from all public bicycle hire systems which provide data, and will be expanded on an ongoing basis as more systems publish open data. Coverage: as stated on the linked page. The list files it under "Mobility and Transportation" (mobility and transport). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the list entry (repository not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and transport studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-awesome-sustainable-technology.
